projectContext.name: WebStore UI Refresh
projectContext.description: React + Tailwind storefront served via Next.js; v5.2.0 featured a clean, balanced three-column catalog layout.

issueStatement: Previously working scenario now fails: the catalog page that looked elegant in v5.2.0 becomes cluttered in v5.3.1—cards overlap, gutters collapse, typography scales inconsistently, and the hero banner ignores safe-area padding due to an over-aggressive Tailwind purge/utility rename. Fix is known; deliver the corrected UI plus before/after evidence.
businessGoals: Restore the v5.2.0 visual balance while retaining new theme tokens.
Guarantee future CSS refactors include automated visual regression coverage.
nonFunctional: Maintain Lighthouse performance within ±2% of v5.2.0.
